source:
Imagine a fashion game called Runway Royale. It has the fun of creating outfits and competing in fashion shows, but with much more to do between rounds.
🌟 Main Lobby
As players join, they enter a huge luxury fashion mall with glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, music, and a spinning central runway. Around the lobby are portals to different game modes, a daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, and event stage.
👗 Dressing Booths
Instead of everyone changing in the open, every player gets their own private dressing booth.
Full-length smart mirrors
Outfit save slots
Makeup and hair stations
Skin tone and body customization
Accessory organizers
Outfit randomizer
Favorite clothing section
Booth themes you can unlock (Fairy, Modern, Princess, Cyber, Beach, Cottagecore, etc.)
🛍️ Non-VIP Fashion Area
Everyone can use hundreds of beautiful items including:
Dresses
Jeans
Skirts
Jackets
Hoodies
Sneakers
Heels
Boots
Hats
Glasses
Hairstyles
Makeup
Jewelry
Bags
Nails
Face accessories
New free clothes are added every week so non-VIP players never feel left behind.
💎 VIP Fashion Lounge
VIP players enter through sparkling golden doors into a luxury boutique.
VIP includes:
Exclusive designer collections
Animated dresses
Wings
Luxury gowns
Fantasy outfits
Premium hairstyles
Designer handbags
Exclusive makeup
Particle effects
Glowing accessories
Special poses
VIP-only dressing booths
Private runway practice room
VIP chat lounge
🎭 Fashion Themes
Every round gives a random theme, such as:
Mermaid Royalty
First Day of School
Pop Star
Vampire Queen
Winter Wonderland
Space Explorer
Cottage Princess
Y2K
Gothic Glam
Red Carpet
Fairy Forest
Pirate Captain
Summer Vacation
Magical Academy
Celebrity Look
Players have 5 minutes to create their outfits.
✨ Runway Show
When time is up:
Players walk down a stunning animated runway.
Spotlights follow each model.
Cameras flash.
Music changes with each round.
Players strike poses before reaching the judges.
⭐ Voting
Instead of simple stars, players earn points for:
Creativity
Theme accuracy
Styling
Color coordination
Overall wow factor
The top three receive crowns, confetti, and bonus rewards.
🏆 Progression
Players level up through fashion ranks:
Fashion Rookie
Trendsetter
Style Icon
Elite Designer
Supermodel
Fashion Legend
Runway Royalty
Higher ranks unlock badges, titles, booth decorations, and special victory animations.
📸 Extra Features
Outfit photo studio
Trading accessories
Fashion clubs with friends
Weekly tournaments
Seasonal battle pass
Daily styling challenges
Pet companions
Color wheel with millions of shades
Fabric textures (silk, denim, velvet, lace, leather)
Weather effects on runways
Fashion magazine where winning outfits are displayed
🌈 Why it stands out
Instead of only dressing up and voting, players can collect rare clothing, decorate their own dressing booth, climb fashion leagues, complete quests, trade cosmetics, join fashion teams, and explore a beautiful world that keeps growing with new updates. It feels like a fashion-themed adventure rather than just a runway game, making it deeper and more rewarding while staying fun for casual players.

image_prompt.text: A deliberately oversized luxury fashion-mall lobby built to hold maximum avatar density without traffic jams, with the spinning central runway as its focal point
A dedicated outfit photo studio built specifically as a backdrop for screenshots and posed shots
Portal frames ringing the lobby, each leading to a different game mode
Private dressing booths around the lobby perimeter, plus the VIP boutique behind golden doors and its private runway practice room, all entered from the lobby floor
Glowing waterfalls cascading down the lobby walls
Glass elevators rising through the open lobby volume
Giant digital billboards displaying fashion visuals above the lobby
An event stage for live shows, separate from the competition runway
A trading plaza where players meet to swap accessories
A daily reward fountain at the centre of its own plaza
Non-VIP retail floor with hundreds of clothing items on elegant racks and mannequins
Full-length smart mirrors, makeup and hair stations and accessory organisers fitted inside each dressing booth
Sparkling golden doors gating the VIP lounge from the main floor
A judges' panel at the end of the runway that models pose in front of
Spotlights that track each model down the runway

layout_placement.text: Teleport markers at each lobby portal linking to the game modes
A daily reward trigger at the fountain that fires once per player per day
An access-gated volume at the golden doors admitting VIP players only

notes: P3 comes from the enterable dressing booths, VIP boutique and practice room; if booths are per-player instances this also becomes P4.
The central runway is described as spinning, which the stage-runway shape does not carry as a property.
Round structure - themed rounds, a 5-minute styling timer, a walk phase and a voting phase - has no field in this handoff.
Booth themes are unlockable (Fairy, Modern, Princess, Cyber, Beach, Cottagecore), so the booth interiors are variant-dressed rather than fixed.

open_questions.ask: Is the mall lobby, the runway and the VIP wing all one continuous space, or does each mode sit on its own map reached through the portals?
Are the dressing booths private per-player instances, or physical rooms in the shared lobby that anyone can walk into?

theme: Luxury glam fashion mall - sparkling, high-gloss, oversaturated, close to Stylized / Toon but with a couture polish

answers.ask: Is the mall lobby, the runway and the VIP wing all one continuous space, or does each mode sit on its own map reached through the portals?
answers.answer: Keep the luxury mall lobby and VIP wing as one continuous shared space, with portals leading to separate runway-show maps for rounds.

answers.ask: Are the dressing booths private per-player instances, or physical rooms in the shared lobby that anyone can walk into?
answers.answer: Dressing booths are private per-player instances, so each player can customize outfits without others entering or seeing their booth.
